posts.body:
Second script of the day! Sorry.
Is there a way to make a battle HUD like this? (Sorry I'm no artist ;-; )
I know google exists but, I just want to get recommendations. It would not be animated whatsoever: What would change are the windows. Where the characters are, would be the portraits.

  def self.actor_index
    return @actor_index
  end
end

class Window_BattleLog < Window_Selectable
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Object Initialization
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    super(140, 0, window_width, window_height)
    self.z = 200
    self.opacity = 0
    @lines = []
    @num_wait = 0
    create_back_bitmap
    create_back_sprite
    refresh
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Window Width
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def window_width
    Graphics.width - 280
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Create Background Sprite
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Window_PartyCommand < Window_Command
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Object Initialization
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def initialize
    super(Graphics.width / 2 - window_width / 2, Graphics.height / 2 - fitting_height(visible_line_number) / 2)
    self.openness = 0
    deactivate
  end
end

class Window_ActorCommand < Window_Command
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Setup
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def setup(actor)
    @actor = actor
    index = BattleManager.actor_index
    clear_command_list
    case index
    when 0
      self.x = 142
      self.y = 15
    when 1
      self.x = Graphics.width - 143 - self.width
      self.y = 15
    when 2
      self.x = 142
      self.y = Graphics.height - 140
    when 3
      self.x = Graphics.width - 143 - self.width
      self.y = Graphics.height - 140
    end
    make_command_list
    refresh
    select(0)
    activate
    open
  end
end

class Window_BattleStatus < Window_Selectable
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: initialize
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def initialize
    super(0, 0, window_width, window_height)
    @op = self.opacity
    self.openness = 0
    self.opacity = 0
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Window Width
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def window_width
    Graphics.width
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Window Height
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def window_height
    Graphics.height
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Number of Items
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def item_max
    $game_party.battle_members.size
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Refresh
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def refresh
    contents.clear
    draw_all_items
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Digit Count
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def col_max
    return 2
  end

  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Row Count
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def row_max
    return 2
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: actor
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def actor; return $game_party.battle_members[@index]; end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_item
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_item(index)
    return if index.nil?
    clear_item(index)
    actor = $game_party.battle_members[index]
    rect = item_rect(index)
    return if actor.nil?
    draw_window_frame(rect.x-5, rect.y-5, rect.width+10, rect.height+5)
    draw_actor_face(actor, rect.x+2, rect.y+2, actor.alive?)
    draw_actor_name(actor, rect.x, rect.y, rect.width-8)
    draw_actor_action(actor, rect.x, rect.y)
    draw_actor_icons(actor, rect.x, rect.y+25, rect.width)
    contents.font.size = 16
    draw_actor_hp(actor, rect.x+2, rect.y+60, rect.width-4)
    draw_actor_mp(actor, rect.x+2, rect.y+75, rect.width-4)
    draw_actor_tp(actor, rect.x+2, rect.y+90, rect.width-4)
  end

  def get_window_colour
    adj = 0
    r = $game_system.window_tone.red.to_i
    g = $game_system.window_tone.green.to_i
    b = $game_system.window_tone.blue.to_i
    adj = r * -1 if r < 0 && (r < (g || b))
    adj = g * -1 if g < 0 && (g < (r || b))
    adj = b * -1 if b < 0 && (b < (r || g))
    if adj > 0
      adj = 50 if adj > 50
      r = r + adj
      g = g + adj
      b = b + adj
    end
    a = @op
    t = Color.new(r, g, b, a)
    return t
  end

  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: draw_window_frame
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_window_frame(x, y, w, h)
    contents.blt(x, y, windowskin, Rect.new(64,0,16,16))
    contents.blt(x+w-16, y, windowskin, Rect.new(112,0,16,16))
    contents.blt(x, y+h-16, windowskin, Rect.new(64,48,16,16))
    contents.blt(x+w-16, y+h-16, windowskin, Rect.new(112,48,16,16))
    contents.fill_rect(x + 4, y + 4, 120, 115, get_window_colour)
    i=0
    while i < w-32 do
      contents.blt(x+i+4, y, windowskin, Rect.new(80,0,[w-10-i,32].min,16))
      contents.blt(x+i+4, y+h-16, windowskin, Rect.new(80,48,[w-10-i,32].min,16))
      i+=32
    end
    i=0
    while i < h-32 do
      contents.blt(x, y+4+i, windowskin, Rect.new(64,16,16,[h-32-i,32].min))
      contents.blt(x+w-16, y+4+i, windowskin, Rect.new(112,16,16,[h-32-i,32].min))
      contents.blt(x, y+26+i, windowskin, Rect.new(64,16,16,[h-32-i,32].min))
      contents.blt(x+w-16, y+26+i, windowskin, Rect.new(112,16,16,[h-32-i,32].min))
      i+=32
    end  
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: item_rect
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def item_rect(index)
    rect = Rect.new
    rect.width = 120
    rect.height = 120
    case index
    when 0
      rect.x = 5
      rect.y = 5
    when 1
      rect.x = Graphics.width - 150
      rect.y = 5
    when 2
      rect.x = 5
      rect.y = Graphics.height - 150
    when 3
      rect.x = Graphics.width - 150
      rect.y = Graphics.height - 150
    end
    return rect
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_face
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_face(face_name, face_index, dx, dy, enabled = true)
    bitmap = Cache.face(face_name)
    fx = [(96 - item_rect(0).width + 1) / 2, 0].max
    fy = face_index / 4 * 96 + 2
    fw = [item_rect(0).width - 4, 92].min
    rect = Rect.new(fx, fy, fw, 92)
    rect = Rect.new(face_index % 4 * 96 + fx, fy, fw, 92)
    contents.blt(dx, dy, bitmap, rect, enabled ? 255 : translucent_alpha)
    bitmap.dispose
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_actor_name
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_actor_name(actor, dx, dy, dw = 112)
    reset_font_settings
    contents.font.size = 16
    change_color(hp_color(actor))
    draw_text(dx+24, dy, dw-24, line_height, actor.name)
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_current_and_max_values
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_current_and_max_values(dx, dy, dw, current, max, color1, color2)
    change_color(color1)
    draw_text(dx, dy, dw, line_height, current, 2)
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: draw_actor_action
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_actor_action(actor, dx, dy)
    draw_icon(action_icon(actor), dx, dy)
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: action_icon
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def action_icon(actor)
    return 0 if actor.current_action.nil?
    return 0 if actor.current_action.item.nil?
    return actor.current_action.item.icon_index
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_actor_hp
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_actor_hp(actor, dx, dy, width = 124)
    draw_gauge(dx, dy, width, actor.hp_rate, hp_gauge_color1, hp_gauge_color2)
    change_color(system_color)
    cy = (Font.default_size - contents.font.size) / 2 + 1
    draw_text(dx+2, dy+cy, 30, line_height, Vocab::hp_a)
    draw_current_and_max_values(dx, dy+cy, width, actor.hp, actor.mhp,
      hp_color(actor), normal_color)
    end
   
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_actor_mp
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_actor_mp(actor, dx, dy, width = 124)
    draw_gauge(dx, dy, width, actor.mp_rate, mp_gauge_color1, mp_gauge_color2)
    change_color(system_color)
    cy = (Font.default_size - contents.font.size) / 2 + 1
    draw_text(dx+2, dy+cy, 30, line_height, Vocab::mp_a)
    draw_current_and_max_values(dx, dy+cy, width, actor.mp, actor.mmp,
    mp_color(actor), normal_color)
  end
   
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_actor_tp
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_actor_tp(actor, dx, dy, width = 124)
    draw_gauge(dx, dy, width, actor.tp_rate, tp_gauge_color1, tp_gauge_color2)
    change_color(system_color)
    cy = (Font.default_size - contents.font.size) / 2 + 1
    draw_text(dx+2, dy+cy, 30, line_height, Vocab::tp_a)
    change_color(tp_color(actor))
    draw_text(dx + width - 42, dy+cy, 42, line_height, actor.tp.to_i, 2)
  end
end

class Window_BattleActor < Window_BattleStatus
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● window display
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def show
    @old_index = nil
    select(0) if @index < 0
    super
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Window update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update
    super
    update_target_anim
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Target anime update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_target_anim
    if @index != @old_index
      refresh
      @old_index = @index
      rect = item_rect(@index)
      draw_highlight_frame(rect.x-5, rect.y-5, rect.width+10, rect.height+5)
    end
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: draw_window_frame
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_window_frame(x, y, w, h)
    contents.blt(x, y, windowskin, Rect.new(64,0,16,16), 120)
    contents.blt(x+w-16, y, windowskin, Rect.new(112,0,16,16), 120)
    contents.blt(x, y+h-16, windowskin, Rect.new(64,48,16,16), 120)
    contents.blt(x+w-16, y+h-16, windowskin, Rect.new(112,48,16,16), 120)
    contents.fill_rect(x + 4, y + 4, 120, 115, get_window_colour)
    i=0
    while i < w-32 do
      contents.blt(x+16+i, y, windowskin, Rect.new(80,0,[w-32-i,32].min,16), 120)
      contents.blt(x+16+i, y+h-16, windowskin, Rect.new(80,48,[w-32-i,32].min,16), 120)
      i+=32
    end
    i=0
    while i < h-32 do
      contents.blt(x, y+16+i, windowskin, Rect.new(64,16,16,[h-32-i,32].min), 120)
      contents.blt(x+w-16, y+16+i, windowskin, Rect.new(112,16,16,[h-32-i,32].min), 120)
      i+=32
    end  
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: draw_window_frame
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_highlight_frame(x, y, w, h)
    contents.blt(x, y, windowskin, Rect.new(64,0,16,16), 255)
    contents.blt(x+w-16, y, windowskin, Rect.new(112,0,16,16), 255)
    contents.blt(x, y+h-16, windowskin, Rect.new(64,48,16,16), 255)
    contents.blt(x+w-16, y+h-16, windowskin, Rect.new(112,48,16,16), 255)
    i=0
    while i < w-32 do
      contents.blt(x+16+i, y, windowskin, Rect.new(80,0,[w-32-i,32].min,16), 255)
      contents.blt(x+16+i, y+h-16, windowskin, Rect.new(80,48,[w-32-i,32].min,16), 255)
      i+=32
    end
    i=0
    while i < h-32 do
      contents.blt(x, y+16+i, windowskin, Rect.new(64,16,16,[h-32-i,32].min), 255)
      contents.blt(x+w-16, y+16+i, windowskin, Rect.new(112,16,16,[h-32-i,32].min), 255)
      i+=32
    end  
  end
 
end

class Window_BattleEnemy < Window_Selectable
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Object Initialization
  #     info_viewport : Viewport for displaying information
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def initialize(info_viewport)
    super(140, 0, window_width, fitting_height(4))
    refresh
    self.visible = false
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Window Width
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def window_width
    Graphics.width - 282
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● window display
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def show
    @target_anim_on = true
    @old_index = nil
    aindex = BattleManager.actor_index
    case aindex
    when 0, 1
      self.y = Graphics.height - self.height - 20
    when 2, 3
      self.y = 15
    end
    select(0) if @index < 0
    super
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Hiding a window
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias hide2 hide
  def hide
    old_enemy.sprite_effect_type = :whiten_loop_stop if @old_index != nil
    enemy.sprite_effect_type = :whiten_loop_stop
    @target_anim_on = false
    @old_index = nil
    hide2
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Window update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update
    super
    update_target_anim
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Target anime update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_target_anim
    return if @target_anim_on == nil
    if @target_anim_on && @index != @old_index
      old_enemy.sprite_effect_type = :whiten_loop_stop if @old_index != nil
      enemy.sprite_effect_type = :whiten_loop if enemy
    end
    @old_index = @index   
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Get previous enemy character object
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def old_enemy
    $game_troop.alive_members[@old_index]
  end

end

class Sprite_Battler < Sprite_Base

  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Start of effect
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def start_effect(effect_type)
    @effect_type = effect_type
    case @effect_type
    when :appear
      @effect_duration = 16
      @battler_visible = true
    when :disappear
      @effect_duration = 32
      @battler_visible = false
    when :whiten
      @effect_duration = 16
      @battler_visible = true
    when :blink
      @effect_duration = 20
      @battler_visible = true
    when :collapse
      @effect_duration = 48
      @battler_visible = false
    when :boss_collapse
      @effect_duration = bitmap.height
      @battler_visible = false
    when :instant_collapse
      @effect_duration = 16
      @battler_visible = false
    when :whiten_loop
      @whiten_cnt = 0.0
      @effect_duration = -1
      @battler_visible = true
    when :whiten_loop_stop
      @effect_duration = -1
    end
    revert_to_normal
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Effect update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias update_effect2 update_effect
  def update_effect
    update_effect2
    if @effect_duration < 0
      case @effect_type
      when :whiten_loop
        update_whiten_loop
      when :whiten_loop_stop
        update_whiten_loop_stop
      end
    end
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Effect on selection
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_whiten_loop
    d=(-90+@whiten_cnt/180)*Math::PI
    col = 255 * Math.sin(d)
    @whiten_cnt += 6
    @whiten_cnt %= 180       
    self.color.set(col, col, col, col)
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Effect ends when selected
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_whiten_loop_stop
    @whiten_cnt = 0.0
    self.color.set(0, 0, 0, 0)
    @effect_duration = 0
    @effect_type = nil
  end

end

class Scene_Battle < Scene_Base
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Update Information Display Viewport
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_info_viewport
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Create Status Window
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def create_status_window
    @status_window = Window_BattleStatus.new
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Create Information Display Viewport
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def create_info_viewport
    @info_viewport = Viewport.new
    @info_viewport.z = 100
    @status_window.viewport = @info_viewport
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Create Party Commands Window
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def create_party_command_window
    @party_command_window = Window_PartyCommand.new
    @party_command_window.viewport = @info_viewport
    @party_command_window.set_handler(:fight,  method(:command_fight))
    @party_command_window.set_handler(:escape, method(:command_escape))
    @party_command_window.unselect
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Create Actor Commands Window
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def create_actor_command_window
    @actor_command_window = Window_ActorCommand.new
    @actor_command_window.viewport = @info_viewport
    @actor_command_window.set_handler(:attack, method(:command_attack))
    @actor_command_window.set_handler(:skill,  method(:command_skill))
    @actor_command_window.set_handler(:guard,  method(:command_guard))
    @actor_command_window.set_handler(:item,   method(:command_item))
    @actor_command_window.set_handler(:cancel, method(:prior_command))
    @actor_command_window.hide
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * To Previous Command Input
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def prior_command
    if BattleManager.prior_command
      start_actor_command_selection
    else
      @actor_command_window.hide
      start_party_command_selection
    end
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Start Actor Command Selection
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def start_actor_command_selection
    @status_window.select(BattleManager.actor.index)
    @party_command_window.close
    @actor_command_window.setup(BattleManager.actor)
    @actor_command_window.show
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Start Turn
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def turn_start
    @actor_command_window.hide
    @party_command_window.close
    @actor_command_window.close
    @status_window.unselect
    @subject =  nil
    BattleManager.turn_start
    @log_window.wait
    @log_window.clear
  end
end

class Window_BattleStatus < Window_Selectable
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: initialize
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def initialize
    super(0, 0, window_width, window_height)
    self.openness = 0
    self.opacity = 0
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Window Width
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def window_width
    Graphics.width
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Window Height
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def window_height
    Graphics.height
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Number of Items
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def item_max
    $game_party.battle_members.size
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Refresh
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def refresh
    contents.clear
    draw_all_items
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Digit Count
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def col_max
    return 2
  end

  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Get Row Count
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def row_max
    return 2
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: actor
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def actor; return $game_party.battle_members[@index]; end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_item
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_item(index)
    return if index.nil?
    clear_item(index)
    actor = $game_party.battle_members[index]
    rect = item_rect(index)
    return if actor.nil?
    draw_window_frame(rect.x-5, rect.y-5, rect.width+10, rect.height+5)
    draw_actor_face(actor, rect.x+2, rect.y+2, actor.alive?)
    draw_actor_name(actor, rect.x, rect.y, rect.width-8)
    draw_actor_action(actor, rect.x, rect.y)
    draw_actor_icons(actor, rect.x, rect.y+25, rect.width)
    contents.font.size = 16
    draw_actor_hp(actor, rect.x+2, rect.y+60, rect.width-4)
    draw_actor_mp(actor, rect.x+2, rect.y+75, rect.width-4)
    draw_actor_tp(actor, rect.x+2, rect.y+90, rect.width-4)
  end

  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: draw_window_frame
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_window_frame(x, y, w, h)
    contents.blt(x, y, windowskin, Rect.new(64,0,16,16))
    contents.blt(x+w-16, y, windowskin, Rect.new(112,0,16,16))
    contents.blt(x, y+h-16, windowskin, Rect.new(64,48,16,16))
    contents.blt(x+w-16, y+h-16, windowskin, Rect.new(112,48,16,16))
    contents.fill_rect(x + 4, y + 4, 120, 115, R2_Corner_Status_Back_Color::Back)
    i=0
    while i < w-32 do
      contents.blt(x+16+i, y, windowskin, Rect.new(80,0,[w-32-i,32].min,16))
      contents.blt(x+16+i, y+h-16, windowskin, Rect.new(80,48,[w-32-i,32].min,16))
      i+=32
    end
    i=0
    while i < h-32 do
      contents.blt(x, y+16+i, windowskin, Rect.new(64,16,16,[h-32-i,32].min))
      contents.blt(x+w-16, y+16+i, windowskin, Rect.new(112,16,16,[h-32-i,32].min))
      i+=32
    end  
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: item_rect
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def item_rect(index)
    rect = Rect.new
    rect.width = 120
    rect.height = 120
    case index
    when 0
      rect.x = 5
      rect.y = 5
    when 1
      rect.x = Graphics.width - 150
      rect.y = 5
    when 2
      rect.x = 5
      rect.y = Graphics.height - 150
    when 3
      rect.x = Graphics.width - 150
      rect.y = Graphics.height - 150
    end
    return rect
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_face
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_face(face_name, face_index, dx, dy, enabled = true)
    bitmap = Cache.face(face_name)
    fx = [(96 - item_rect(0).width + 1) / 2, 0].max
    fy = face_index / 4 * 96 + 2
    fw = [item_rect(0).width - 4, 92].min
    rect = Rect.new(fx, fy, fw, 92)
    rect = Rect.new(face_index % 4 * 96 + fx, fy, fw, 92)
    contents.blt(dx, dy, bitmap, rect, enabled ? 255 : translucent_alpha)
    bitmap.dispose
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_actor_name
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_actor_name(actor, dx, dy, dw = 112)
    reset_font_settings
    contents.font.size = 16
    change_color(hp_color(actor))
    draw_text(dx+24, dy, dw-24, line_height, actor.name)
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_current_and_max_values
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_current_and_max_values(dx, dy, dw, current, max, color1, color2)
    change_color(color1)
    draw_text(dx, dy, dw, line_height, current, 2)
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: draw_actor_action
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_actor_action(actor, dx, dy)
    draw_icon(action_icon(actor), dx, dy)
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: action_icon
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def action_icon(actor)
    return 0 if actor.current_action.nil?
    return 0 if actor.current_action.item.nil?
    return actor.current_action.item.icon_index
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_actor_hp
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_actor_hp(actor, dx, dy, width = 124)
    draw_gauge(dx, dy, width, actor.hp_rate, hp_gauge_color1, hp_gauge_color2)
    change_color(system_color)
    cy = (Font.default_size - contents.font.size) / 2 + 1
    draw_text(dx+2, dy+cy, 30, line_height, Vocab::hp_a)
    draw_current_and_max_values(dx, dy+cy, width, actor.hp, actor.mhp,
      hp_color(actor), normal_color)
    end
   
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_actor_mp
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_actor_mp(actor, dx, dy, width = 124)
    draw_gauge(dx, dy, width, actor.mp_rate, mp_gauge_color1, mp_gauge_color2)
    change_color(system_color)
    cy = (Font.default_size - contents.font.size) / 2 + 1
    draw_text(dx+2, dy+cy, 30, line_height, Vocab::mp_a)
    draw_current_and_max_values(dx, dy+cy, width, actor.mp, actor.mmp,
    mp_color(actor), normal_color)
  end
   
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: draw_actor_tp
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_actor_tp(actor, dx, dy, width = 124)
    draw_gauge(dx, dy, width, actor.tp_rate, tp_gauge_color1, tp_gauge_color2)
    change_color(system_color)
    cy = (Font.default_size - contents.font.size) / 2 + 1
    draw_text(dx+2, dy+cy, 30, line_height, Vocab::tp_a)
    change_color(tp_color(actor))
    draw_text(dx + width - 42, dy+cy, 42, line_height, actor.tp.to_i, 2)
  end
end

    @old_index = nil
    aindex = BattleManager.actor_index
    case aindex
    when 0, 1
      self.y = Graphics.height - self.height - 10
    when 2, 3
      self.y = 10
    end
    select(0) if @index < 0
    super
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Hiding a window
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias hide2 hide
  def hide
    old_enemy.sprite_effect_type = :whiten_loop_stop if @old_index != nil
    enemy.sprite_effect_type = :whiten_loop_stop
    @target_anim_on = false
    @old_index = nil
    hide2
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Window update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update
    super
    update_target_anim
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Target anime update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_target_anim
    return if @target_anim_on == nil
    if @target_anim_on && @index != @old_index
      old_enemy.sprite_effect_type = :whiten_loop_stop if @old_index != nil
      enemy.sprite_effect_type = :whiten_loop if enemy
    end
    @old_index = @index  
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Get previous enemy character object
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def old_enemy
    $game_troop.alive_members[@old_index]
  end

end

class Sprite_Battler < Sprite_Base

  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Start of effect
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def start_effect(effect_type)
    @effect_type = effect_type
    case @effect_type
    when :appear
      @effect_duration = 16
      @battler_visible = true
    when :disappear
      @effect_duration = 32
      @battler_visible = false
    when :whiten
      @effect_duration = 16
      @battler_visible = true
    when :blink
      @effect_duration = 20
      @battler_visible = true
    when :collapse
      @effect_duration = 48
      @battler_visible = false
    when :boss_collapse
      @effect_duration = bitmap.height
      @battler_visible = false
    when :instant_collapse
      @effect_duration = 16
      @battler_visible = false
    when :whiten_loop
      @whiten_cnt = 0.0
      @effect_duration = -1
      @battler_visible = true
    when :whiten_loop_stop
      @effect_duration = -1
    end
    revert_to_normal
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Effect update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias update_effect2 update_effect
  def update_effect
    update_effect2
    if @effect_duration < 0
      case @effect_type
      when :whiten_loop
        update_whiten_loop
      when :whiten_loop_stop
        update_whiten_loop_stop
      end
    end
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Effect on selection
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_whiten_loop
    d=(-90+@whiten_cnt/180)*Math::PI
    col = 255 * Math.sin(d)
    @whiten_cnt += 6
    @whiten_cnt %= 180      
    self.color.set(col, col, col, col)
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ● Effect ends when selected
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_whiten_loop_stop
    @whiten_cnt = 0.0
    self.color.set(0, 0, 0, 0)
    @effect_duration = 0
    @effect_type = nil
  end

end

class Scene_Battle < Scene_Base
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Update Information Display Viewport
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_info_viewport
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Create Status Window
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def create_status_window
    @status_window = Window_BattleStatus.new
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Create Information Display Viewport
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def create_info_viewport
    @info_viewport = Viewport.new
    @info_viewport.z = 100
    @status_window.viewport = @info_viewport
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Create Party Commands Window
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def create_party_command_window
    @party_command_window = Window_PartyCommand.new
    @party_command_window.viewport = @info_viewport
    @party_command_window.set_handler(:fight,  method(:command_fight))
    @party_command_window.set_handler(:escape, method(:command_escape))
    @party_command_window.unselect
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Create Actor Commands Window
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def create_actor_command_window
    @actor_command_window = Window_ActorCommand.new
    @actor_command_window.viewport = @info_viewport
    @actor_command_window.set_handler(:attack, method(:command_attack))
    @actor_command_window.set_handler(:skill,  method(:command_skill))
    @actor_command_window.set_handler(:guard,  method(:command_guard))
    @actor_command_window.set_handler(:item,   method(:command_item))
    @actor_command_window.set_handler(:cancel, method(:prior_command))
    @actor_command_window.hide
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * To Previous Command Input
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def prior_command
    if BattleManager.prior_command
      start_actor_command_selection
    else
      @actor_command_window.hide
      start_party_command_selection
    end
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Start Actor Command Selection
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def start_actor_command_selection
    @status_window.select(BattleManager.actor.index)
    @party_command_window.close
    @actor_command_window.setup(BattleManager.actor)
    @actor_command_window.show
  end
 
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Start Turn
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def turn_start
    @actor_command_window.hide
    @party_command_window.close
    @actor_command_window.close
    @status_window.unselect
    @subject =  nil
    BattleManager.turn_start
    @log_window.wait
    @log_window.clear
  end
end

pochijp said:
is there any way to make the windows color match with the windows color for the game?
Click to expand...
There is no direct way to do this, but I can make it close. The window color is a tone set on windows.
In my script I extended the window to the full size of the screen and positioned the actors in the corners.
This means I cannot use the window background because that would make the entire screen the window color.
So what is done instead is a process called contents fill rect , which needs a color value and tone cannot be used. taking the values in tone and applying it to the window color makes it red not blue.
But I did an adjustment to the values so it is closer to the default. It seems to work almost perfectly (at least from my eyes)
